name: Evelyn Mase
contribution: The first wife of the South African anti-apartheid activist and the future president Nelson Mandela, to whom she was married from 1944 to 1958.

checks.lead: Evelyn Ntoko Mase (18 May 1922 – 30 April 2004), later named Evelyn Rakeepile, was the first wife of the South African anti-apartheid activist and the future president Nelson Mandela, to whom she was married from 1944 to 1958. Mase was a nurse by profession.
